lastCompletedStory.title: Add merit-over-cost rule to subagent-auditor (both copies)

nextStoryContext: Added a new item 19 ('Merit over cost.') to section E (Repo invariants) of both .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md, framed for AUDIT ('Do NOT APPROVE a PRD whose scope or quality was trimmed for effort or cost reasons...'), carrying the dictated verbatim shared sentence identical to US-001's reviewer wording ('This rule limits the quality of the recommendation, not its scope: Simplicity remains the scope limiter. Operational cost is never a criterion, but quality degradation from context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion, not a cost one.'). Section E (items 1-18) is identical text in both the .claude/ and templates/ copies, so it was the correct insertion point (NOT the cam-cli-only '### F. Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor`; embed-vendor:check and test/embedded.test.ts (63 pass) both green; full bun test suite 5256 pass / 0 fail. No pattern-records.jsonl exists in this repo yet (checked again, still absent), so appliedPatternIds is empty.
